newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) end mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) end mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 3.553 billion yuan from 4.8 billion on Wednesday and the most active one was the 60-day contract.
Traders said the most active buyers were still non-banking financial institutions who borrowed heavily from short-term financial centres in order to buy the day's two new A share issues.
But today's plunge in the A share secondary market prevented the rates from going up further, one local trader said.

The central bank's plan to boost the quota for re-discounting of bills by 20 billion yuan this year, which was announced late on Wednesday, would increase China's money supply and limit the rates in the long-term, a second trader said.
